title: Classics and Ancient Mediterranean Studies, B.A. -- CAMS Option (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Pre-2025 curriculum, built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin's Suggested Academic Plan ('Classics and Ancient Mediterranean Option: ... at University Park Campus and Commonwealth Campuses' table, Total Credits 123) and Program Requirements tabs (confirmed byte-identical to the 2023-24 archive's own CAMS-option table and degree-requirements table -- the only textual diffs between the two archived pages are a cosmetic Gen Ed foundations sentence and one blank course-title cell in the Archaeology option's elective table, neither of which touches this option's own sequence). Real, genuine differences from CAMS-2026.json's current plan: no 'LA 83' / 'LA 283' Liberal Arts seminar courses exist in this era's sequence at all (those were added starting with the 2025-26 bulletin); World Language is a straight Level 1 (Fall 1, 4cr) -> Level 2 (Spring 1, 4cr) -> Level 3 (Fall 2, 4cr) progression instead of 2026's Level 1/Level 2 both loaded into Semester 2; and Semester 1 here totals 16cr across 5 items (no CAMS 00/100-level course in Fall 1 -- that slot is in Spring 1 instead), not 16.5cr across 6 items. Fourth-year Fall's University Cultures slot is labeled 'Other Cultures' in this and the 2023-24 archive (renamed 'World Cultures' starting 2024-25, see CAMS-2024.json). Entrance to major (2.00 GPA, third-semester classification) and the CAMS 5 / CAMS 400W prescribed-course requirements are unchanged from the current plan's own notes. Same generic-slot conventions as CAMS-2026.json (GEN ED, B.A. Knowledge Domain, Elective, CAMS 00/100-level, CAMS 100+, 400-level CAMS/Ancient Language, 400-level CAMS/Related Area all modeled as open slots, matching the bulletin's own open-range phrasing). Superseded by the 2025-26 LA 83/LA 283 curriculum change (see CAMS-2025.json / CAMS-2026.json).
